title: OpportunityScore
description: Standardized 8-dimensional opportunity scoring schema for indie hackers and solo founders, featuring weighted rubric calculation and fatal kill-criteria gates.

id.description: Unique identifier for this opportunity evaluation (e.g. opp-20260908-docker-cache-guardian).

cluster_id.description: Reference ID to the clustered group of pain cards.

title.description: Descriptive opportunity title (e.g., 'Automated GitHub Actions Docker Cache Optimizer').

one_liner.description: One sentence value proposition defining who, what pain, and the proposed lightweight wedge.

evaluator.description: Mode of assessment: automated LLM evaluation, manual human founder review, or hybrid.

dimensions.description: The 8 quantitative dimensions evaluated from 1 to 10 with evidentiary rationale.

pain_intensity.description: 1-10: Severity of problem (1=trivial annoyance, 10=hair-on-fire blocker causing immediate loss).

frequency.description: 1-10: How often the pain occurs (1=once a year, 10=multiple times daily).

workaround_friction.description: 1-10: Inefficiency and fragility of current solutions (1=Google Docs suffices, 10=brittle 500-line shell script + 3 SaaS hacks).

paying_intent.description: 1-10: Evidence of willingness or ability to pay (1=pure free-tier seekers, 10=active budget, paid alternatives, hiring contractors).

cross_source_recurrence.description: 1-10: Volume and multi-platform validation (1=isolated complaint, 10=repeated organic uproar across Reddit, HN, X, Discord).

competitive_gap.description: 1-10: Whitespace in existing market (1=dominated by free/cheap giants, 10=incumbents are bloated, expensive, or neglect this exact workflow).

feasibility_solo_buildability.description: 1-10: Can 1 developer build an MVP in 1-3 weeks? (1=requires 5-year R&D / deep enterprise sales, 10=laser-focused tool shippable in 10 days).

distribution_accessibility.description: 1-10: How easily can the target users be reached? (1=opaque buyers behind procurement walls, 10=concentrated subreddits, GitHub issues, high intent search).

total_weighted_score.description: Calculated score from 0 to 100 based on dimension weights.

hard_kill_filters.description: Predefined fatal filters. If any trigger, the opportunity must NOT proceed directly to building.

paying_intent_below_5.description: True if paying_intent < 5 (Complaint sink without commercial conversion).

unsolvable_for_solo_builder.description: True if feasibility < 4 (Exceeds solo indie execution capacity).

zero_distribution_channel.description: True if distribution < 4 (No repeatable, low-cost way to reach buyers).

is_killed.description: True if any lethal trigger is activated.

kill_reason.description: Explicit post-mortem reason explaining why this opportunity was disqualified.

recommendation.description: Strategic directive: pursue MVP smoke test, do more user interviews, monitor, or drop.

next_action.description: The exact next tactical step (e.g. 'Run 5 Mom Test interviews with authors of cards #1, #3', 'Setup landing page smoke test').

evidence.description: Concrete fact-based justification citing source cards or market realities.

rubric_tier.description: Categorical tier based on the standardized scoring rubric.
